serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Atom Power designs EV charging infrastructure solutions to meet the electrification goals and needs for scaled operations. Each deployment is unified by our Atom Cloud Software Solution, with web and mobile applications that facilitate seamless charger access, comprehensive analytics, streamlined fleet management, operations management, secure payment processing, and efficient energy management, adaptable across local facilities, campuses, regions, or enterprises. This platform is built on a flexible, secure architecture fortified by end-to-end encryption, ensuring protection against spoofing and tampering for maximum customer and organizational data protection. Gain unparalleled visibility, protection, and control over your EV charging infrastructure with Atom Cloud Software Solution.
